description: Validate and normalize a phone number via Lookups v2. Optional `Fields` lets you request carrier info, line_type_intelligence, caller_name, identity_match, etc.

CountryCode.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2. Required only if PhoneNumber is not in E.164.

Fields.description: Comma-separated list of add-ons (e.g. `line_type_intelligence,caller_name`). Billed per field.

PhoneNumber.description: Number to look up (E.164 recommended; Lookups v2 will format if possible)

name: lookup_phone
